title: You can now ask Google Maps’ AI to order food for you
excerpt: The AI-powered “Ask Maps” tool in Google Maps now has Personal Intelligence, and can perform a broader range of personalized and conversational requests.
content_html:
The AI-powered “Ask Maps” tool in Google Maps can now perform a broader range of personalized and conversational requests, including ordering food, finding hotels, and providing suggestions that factor in your existing plans. These are among several new features announced for Ask Maps today, which aim to “make it easier than ever to get more done” without having to close the Google Maps app, according to Google Maps head, Miriam Daniel.

New agentic capabilities include asking Maps to order you food while considering contextual information like specific dietary needs, location, and places you’ve saved. For example, Google says you can ask it to “order spicy pad kee mao with seafood for me to pick up on my way home” before leaving work, and Ask Maps will find open restaurants along your route back that serve that meal. When you select a restaurant, Ask Maps can automatically add the dish to your cart so you can complete the order. Food ordering is rolling out with partners like Square and Toast now, according to Google, with Uber Eats support coming soon.

Ask Maps can now find hotels and local events that suit your specific requirements, such as having a particular aesthetic or being within walking distance of gyms, restaurants, and other facilities. Maps also now allows you to contribute and edit location information conversationally via Ask Maps or the Contribute tab. This includes uploading photographs like storefront signs that Maps will automatically extract information from, such as updated opening hours, before asking you to confirm the suggestion before it’s submitted.

Food ordering, discovering hotels and events, and conversational contributions are rolling out now in the US, with more countries to come over time.

Google Maps has started adding Personal Intelligence too — a Gemini-powered feature that personalizes AI responses by connecting to data from other Google apps. This enables the Ask Maps tool to automatically consider existing plans like upcoming flights or dinner reservations when responding to your requests. Personal Intelligence can connect Ask Maps to your Gmail to start (which is disabled by default, according to Google), with support for other apps like Calendar coming soon.

Lastly, real-time transit information has also been added to the Ask Maps feature, allowing you to check live updates for any delays to your next bus, train, subway, or ferry ride. The live transit widget and more personalized responses are rolling out now to everywhere Ask Maps is available — which as of today, has been expanded to include Australia, Brazil, Canada, Indonesia, Japan and Mexico.

content_html_zh:
Google 地图中由人工智能驱动的“Ask Maps”工具现在可以执行更广泛的个性化和对话式请求，包括订餐、查找酒店以及提供考虑到现有计划的建议。 谷歌地图负责人 Miriam Daniel 表示，这些是今天宣布的 Ask Maps 的几项新功能之一，这些新功能的目的是“让人们比以往更轻松地完成更多工作”，而无需关闭谷歌地图应用程序。

新的代理功能包括要求地图为您订餐，同时考虑特定饮食需求、位置和您保存的地点等上下文信息。 例如，谷歌表示，你可以在下班前要求它“订购带有海鲜的辣炒河粉记茂，让我在回家的路上取货”，而“问地图”会在你回来的路上找到提供这顿饭的开​​放餐厅。 当您选择一家餐厅时，Ask Maps 可以自动将菜肴添加到您的购物车，以便您完成订单。 据谷歌称，食品订购现已与 Square 和 Toast 等合作伙伴一起推出，Uber Eats 的支持也即将推出。

Ask Maps 现在可以找到适合您特定要求的酒店和当地活动，例如具有特定的美感或步行即可到达健身房、餐厅和其他设施。 地图现在还允许您通过“询问地图”或“贡献”选项卡以对话方式贡献和编辑位置信息。 这包括上传店面标志等照片，地图会自动从中提取信息，例如更新的营业时间，然后在提交建议之前要求您确认。

订餐、发现酒店和活动以及对话贡献功能现已在美国推出，随着时间的推移，还会在更多国家推出。

谷歌地图也开始添加个人智能——这是一项由 Gemini 支持的功能，可以通过连接其他谷歌应用程序的数据来个性化人工智能响应。 这使得“地图询问”工具在响应您的请求时能够自动考虑现有计划，例如即将起飞的航班或晚餐预订。 个人智能可以将“询问地图”连接到您的 Gmail 来启动（根据 Google 的说法，默认情况下禁用），并且即将推出对“日历”等其他应用程序的支持。

最后，实时交通信息也已添加到“询问地图”功能中，让您可以查看实时更新，了解下一趟公共汽车、火车、地铁或渡轮是否有延误。 实时交通小部件和更个性化的响应现已在“Ask Maps”可用的所有地方推出，截至目前，已扩展到澳大利亚、巴西、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本和墨西哥。
